Animé par Jean-Christophe Piot, journali: Hosted by Jean-Christophe Piot, journalist and historian, C'est plus compliqué que ça ("It's more complicated than that") has set itself a simple, relentless mission: take the most solid received ideas, the most stubborn legends, the most widespread myths — and demolish them with sources.
Chaque épisode choisit une croyance popu: Each episode picks a popular belief and explains, with rigour and humour, why it's false or truncated. No, the droit du seigneur didn't exist in the Middle Ages. No, Greek statues weren't white — they were painted. No, the chastity belt isn't a medieval object. No, Liberty Leading the People doesn't depict the French Revolution, but the July Revolution of 1830.
Format court, narration claire, contenu: Short format, clear narration, relentless content. The perfect podcast to shine at dinner parties — or to realise you've been saying nonsense there for years.
Un podcast qui combine rigueur historiqu: A podcast that combines historical rigour with a light tone — which is rare. Each episode leaves you a little better informed, a little better armed against received ideas, and it's extremely satisfying. Jean-Christophe Piot is both educational and entertaining: no excessive music, no dramatic staging, just narration, anecdotes and a logical flow to dismantle every certainty.
Petit bémol : si on enchaîne plusieurs é: A small drawback: binge several episodes and the format can feel repetitive — the similar structure from one episode to the next and the short length don't always leave time to fully explore the context. But that's a detail: overall, the podcast does its job very well.
